svg.title: Error bound against the number of corrections
svg.desc: On a logarithmic scale, the error bound q to the power k times E zero, with E zero equal to one, falls along a straight line for contraction factors 0.5, 0.8, and 0.9. A dashed line marks the tolerance ten to the minus three. The bounds first meet it after 10, 31, and 66 corrections.
